description: RSAF F-86F painted 714 on display at King Khalid Air Base, 18.27209 42.80595 (aerialvisuals). Inside the base; no public access.

RSAF Lightning F.53 53-687 at King Khalid Air Base (thunder-and-lightnings.co.uk; aerialvisuals site B at 18.27220 42.80607 beside the F-86F). Wikipedia lists a mounted Lightning at 18.272086 42.805935. Painted code unknown. Inside the base.

Lightning F.53 painted 224 on display at King Khalid Air Base, GPS 18.260764 42.795216 (Wikipedia survivor list; aerialvisuals site C). True identity not established; 224 is the painted code. Wikipedia also mentions a further unidentified Lightning at Khamis Mushait, which may be the same as 53-687.
